orders.text:
WPMS No. 1042 of 2020
Hon’ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. B.D. Pande and Mr. Rakshit 
Joshi, Advocates for the petitioner.
Registry has pointed out a defect, 
namely, page nos. 29 & 30 of the writ 
petition are not clear.
Mr. B.D. Pande, learned counsel for 
the petitioner made a statement that 
readable copies of page nos. 29 & 30 will 
be supplied in the Registry on or before 
15.07.2020.
In view of the statement of learned 
counsel for the petitioner, defect, as 
pointed out by the Registry, is overruled. 
Heard learned counsel for the 
petitioner through video conferencing.
Petitioner is permitted to serve 
respondents personally.
Steps to be taken within three days.
List this matter on 16.07.2020, as a 
first case on the Board.
Considering the submission 
advanced by learned counsel for the 
petitioner, it is directed that, till the next 
date of listing, status quo qua suit 
property shall be maintained.
Stay application (CLMA No. 4641 of 
2020) stands disposed of. 
 (Manoj K. Tiwari, J.) Arpan 08.07.2020

WPMS No. 1042 of 2020

Mr. B.D. Pande, Advocate for the 
petitioner. 
Mr. Jitendra Chaudhary, Advocate for 
the respondents.

Mr. B.D. Pande, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. Jitendra Chaudhary, Advocate for the

Admit the petition.

List thereafter.
